prediction: The ParsePosition index will not increment when the parser encounters a quote, causing the loop in applyPattern to repeatedly process the same character.
experiment_rationale: The bug report provides a clear fix: adding next(pos) to advance the ParsePosition. The stack trace and the provided code snippet confirm that the current implementation does not advance the position, which is a classic cause of infinite loops in parsing logic.
